risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder's weight stamp or a weight verification certificate.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped weight (e.g., 12.5kg) and expiry date on the cylinder.
Photo of the regulator showing its model number and specifications.
Video of the regulator working or a photo of the valve being operated.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
